description:
The agent must:
1. READ the SKILL.md to discover the proprietary rules (24-month total cost, <70% speed threshold, required incident log fields).
2. For provider_comparison.json: Parse all 4 providers from the messy text. Calculate 24-month TOTAL costs (not monthly) accounting for promotional periods ending, post-promo rates, and equipment fees. Include ETF values. Note technology type (fiber/cable/DSL). Generic agents will only show monthly rates.
3. For diagnostics_report.json: Apply the <70% of contracted speed (500 Mbps) threshold = 350 Mbps flagging rule from SKILL.md. Readings on Mar 5, Mar 12, Mar 18 (×3), Mar 22, Apr 2 fall below 350 Mbps and must be flagged. Must also capture packet loss and classify issues as ISP-side (given the evidence pattern). Generic agents won't know the 70% threshold.
4. For incident_log.json: Structure each incident with ALL 5 required SKILL.md fields: date, time, duration, speedtest results during the issue, and steps attempted. The Mar 18 incident must document the ~7.5-hour duration, multiple speedtest readings showing 48-55 Mbps (10% of contracted), the 42-min ISP hold with denial of outage — all as structured, timestamped evidence for dispute escalation. Generic agents will produce informal summaries missing the required fields.
